content.json:
## ALDC quality metrics

One row per TDD phase, emitted by the `bc-dev` plugin's `SubagentStop` hook.

**Read the independence-ratio first.** Implementer and reviewer draw on the same BCQuality corpus, so the review can quietly stop being a measurement and become a consistency check — this is the only number that shows it happening. Below 0.15 the anti-correlation valve is weakening; at zero the review has stopped measuring.

_BCQuality is a remedial corpus, not a completeness standard: green means no known rule was violated, not that the code is correct._

content.query:
let src = customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.['project']) in ({Project});
let rev = src | where tostring(customDimensions.agent) == 'al-review-subagent';
let agg = rev
| summarize agentF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.agentFindings)),
            totalF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.totalFindings)),
            prescribed = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.prescribed)),
            deviated = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.deviated)),
            undeclared = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.undeclared)),
            cited = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.cited)),
            phases = count();
agg
| project
    ['independence-ratio'] = iff(totalF > 0, round(agentF / totalF, 3), todouble(null)),
    ['deviation rate']     = iff(prescribed > 0, round(deviated / prescribed, 3), todouble(null)),
    ['undeclared deviations'] = undeclared,
    ['cited vs prescribed'] = iff(prescribed > 0, round(cited / prescribed, 3), todouble(null)),
    ['reviews'] = todouble(phases)

customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase' and tostring(customDimensions.agent) == 'al-review-subagent'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.['project']) in ({Project})
| summarize agentF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.agentFindings)),
            totalF = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.totalFindings))
          by bin(timestamp, 7d)
| extend ['independence-ratio'] = iff(totalF > 0, agentF / totalF, todouble(null))
| extend ['floor (0.15)'] = 0.15
| project timestamp, ['independence-ratio'], ['floor (0.15)']
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Independence-ratio, weekly — the anti-correlation signal

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.['project']) in ({Project})
| where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.deviationsDeclared))
| extend paths = split(tostring(customDimensions.deviationsDeclared), '|')
| mv-expand path = paths to typeof(string)
| summarize deviations = count(), projects = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.['project'])) by path
| order by deviations desc
| take 10
content.title: Most-deviated knowledge — candidates for a /custom/ override

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'AldcPhase'
| where '*' in ({Project}) or tostring(customDimensions.['project']) in ({Project})
| summarize phases = count(),
            notMounted = countif(tostring(customDimensions.bcqMounted) == 'false'),
            undeclared = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.undeclared))
          by ['project'] = tostring(customDimensions.['project'])
| extend ['BCQuality missing %'] = round(100.0 * notMounted / phases, 1)
| order by undeclared desc, ['BCQuality missing %'] desc
content.title: Per project — undeclared deviations and runs with BCQuality missing

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == 'AldcHeartbeat'
| summarize machines = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.['project'])), lastSeen = max(timestamp)
          by pluginVersion = tostring(customDimensions.pluginVersion)
| order by lastSeen desc
content.title: bc-dev version adoption — from AldcHeartbeat, not from a review

content.json:
### Estimation — duration ~ planned scope

One row per conductor task (`runId`). **Planned** comes from `AldcEstimate` (the plan's *Planned objects* table, parsed before wave 1); **actual** is the measured `activeSecondsTotal` of the last finished attempt — idle gaps capped at 10 min, human waits after a gate left out. Record schema ≥ 3 and parsed plans (`parseOk = 1`) only; reworks of a finished req are left out; dry runs and self-tests (`exclude=true`) are left out. Set the time range to 90 days for training data.

content.query:
let includeExcluded = false;
let includeRework = false;
let minSchema = 3;
let ev = (n: string) { customEvents
    | where name == n and toint(customDimensions.schema) >= minSchema
    | where includeExcluded or tostring(customDimensions.exclude) != "true"
    | extend runId = tostring(customDimensions.runId)
    | where isnotempty(runId) };
let runTime = ev("AldcRun")
    | extend attempt = todouble(customMeasurements.attempt), activeS = todouble(customMeasurements.activeSeconds)
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, customDimensions, customMeasurements) by runId, attempt, activeS
    | summarize activeSum = sum(activeS), registryTotal = max(todouble(customMeasurements.activeSecondsTotal)),
                finishedAt = maxif(timestamp, tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "done"),
                doneRows = countif(tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "done"),
                rework = max(coalesce(todouble(customMeasurements.rework), 0.0)) by runId
    | where doneRows > 0 and (includeRework or rework == 0)
    | project runId, finishedAt, activeMin = max_of(activeSum, coalesce(registryTotal, 0.0)) / 60;
ev("AldcEstimate")
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, customDimensions, customMeasurements) by runId
| where todouble(customMeasurements.parseOk) == 1
| project runId, tier = tostring(customDimensions.tier),
          estP50Min = todouble(customMeasurements.estP50Min), estP80Min = todouble(customMeasurements.estP80Min)
| where estP80Min > 0
| join kind=inner runTime on runId
| extend withinP80 = toint(activeMin <= estP80Min), ratioP50 = iff(estP50Min > 0, activeMin / estP50Min, real(null))
| summarize runs = count(), shareWithinP80 = round(avg(withinP80), 2),
            medianActualOverP50 = round(percentile(ratioP50, 50), 2)
  by week = startofweek(finishedAt), tier
| order by week desc, tier asc
content.title: Calibration — share of tasks within their P80 (target ≈ 0.8)

content.query:
let includeExcluded = false;
let includeRework = false;
let minSchema = 3;
let ev = (n: string) { customEvents
    | where name == n and toint(customDimensions.schema) >= minSchema
    | where includeExcluded or tostring(customDimensions.exclude) != "true"
    | extend runId = tostring(customDimensions.runId)
    | where isnotempty(runId) };
let runTime = ev("AldcRun")
    | extend attempt = todouble(customMeasurements.attempt), activeS = todouble(customMeasurements.activeSeconds)
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, customDimensions, customMeasurements) by runId, attempt, activeS
    | summarize activeSum = sum(activeS), registryTotal = max(todouble(customMeasurements.activeSecondsTotal)),
                humanWaitSeconds = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.humanWaitSeconds)),
                waveSeconds = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.waveSeconds)),
                runRows = count(), maxAttempts = max(todouble(customMeasurements.attempts)),
                doneRows = countif(tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "done"),
                rework = max(coalesce(todouble(customMeasurements.rework), 0.0)) by runId
    | where doneRows > 0 and (includeRework or rework == 0)
    | extend activeSecondsTotal = max_of(activeSum, coalesce(registryTotal, 0.0)),
             attempts = max_of(coalesce(maxAttempts, 0.0), todouble(runRows))
    | project runId, activeSecondsTotal, humanWaitSeconds, waveSeconds, attempts, rework;
let est = ev("AldcEstimate")
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, customDimensions, customMeasurements) by runId
    | mv-apply k = bag_keys(customMeasurements) to typeof(string) on (
        where k startswith "obj_" | summarize objPlanned = make_bag(bag_pack(k, customMeasurements[k])))
    | project runId, estimatedAt = timestamp, req = tostring(customDimensions.req),
              tier = tostring(customDimensions.tier), model = tostring(customDimensions.model),
              estSource = tostring(customDimensions.estSource), issueNo = tostring(customDimensions.issueNo),
              parseOk = todouble(customMeasurements.parseOk),
              objTotal = todouble(customMeasurements.objTotal), objWeighted = todouble(customMeasurements.objWeighted),
              testCodeunitsPlanned = todouble(customMeasurements.testCodeunitsPlanned),
              wpsPlanned = todouble(customMeasurements.wpsPlanned), wavesPlanned = todouble(customMeasurements.wavesPlanned),
              openQuestions = todouble(customMeasurements.openQuestions),
              hasIntegration = todouble(customMeasurements.hasIntegration), hasEvents = todouble(customMeasurements.hasEvents),
              hasApi = todouble(customMeasurements.hasApi), appObjectCount = todouble(customMeasurements.appObjectCount),
              estP50Min = todouble(customMeasurements.estP50Min), estP80Min = todouble(customMeasurements.estP80Min),
              objPlanned
    | where parseOk == 1;
let run = ev("AldcRun")
    | where tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "done"
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, customDimensions, customMeasurements) by runId
    | mv-apply k = bag_keys(customMeasurements) to typeof(string) on (
        where k startswith "objDone_" | summarize objDone = make_bag(bag_pack(k, customMeasurements[k])))
    | project runId, finishedAt = timestamp, project_ = tostring(customDimensions.['project']),
              user = tostring(customDimensions.user), pluginVersion = tostring(customDimensions.pluginVersion),
              wallMinutesTotal = todouble(customMeasurements.wallMinutesTotal),
              reportedMinutes = todouble(customMeasurements.reportedMinutes),
              fixLoops = todouble(customMeasurements.fixLoops), stops = todouble(customMeasurements.stops),
              wps = todouble(customMeasurements.wps), waves = todouble(customMeasurements.waves),
              testsPassed = todouble(customMeasurements.testsPassed), testsFailed = todouble(customMeasurements.testsFailed),
              alAdded = todouble(customMeasurements.alAdded), alRemoved = todouble(customMeasurements.alRemoved),
              alAddedProd = todouble(customMeasurements.alAddedProd), alAddedTest = todouble(customMeasurements.alAddedTest),
              objDone;
let phaseTokens = customEvents
    | where name == "AldcPhase" and (includeExcluded or tostring(customDimensions.exclude) != "true")
    | extend runId = tostring(customDimensions.runId)
    | where isnotempty(runId)
    | summarize phases = count(), phaseTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.uTokensTotal)),
                phaseOutputTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.uTokensOutput)) by runId;
let sessionTokens = customEvents
    | where name == "AldcSession" and (includeExcluded or tostring(customDimensions.exclude) != "true")
    | extend runId = tostring(customDimensions.runId)
    | where isnotempty(runId)
    | summarize sessions = count(), sessionTokens = sum(todouble(customMeasurements.tokensTotal)) by runId;
est
| join kind=inner runTime on runId
| join kind=inner run on runId
| join kind=leftouter phaseTokens on runId
| join kind=leftouter sessionTokens on runId
| project-away runId1, runId2, runId3, runId4
| extend activeMin = round(activeSecondsTotal / 60, 1)
| order by finishedAt desc
content.title: Estimation dataset — one row per task

content.query:
let includeExcluded = false;
let includeRework = false;
let minSchema = 3;
let ev = (n: string) { customEvents
    | where name == n and toint(customDimensions.schema) >= minSchema
    | where includeExcluded or tostring(customDimensions.exclude) != "true"
    | extend runId = tostring(customDimensions.runId)
    | where isnotempty(runId) };
ev("AldcEstimate")
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, customMeasurements) by runId
| where todouble(customMeasurements.parseOk) == 1
| project runId, pm = customMeasurements
| join kind=inner (ev("AldcRun")
    | where tostring(customDimensions.outcome) == "done"
    | summarize arg_max(timestamp, customMeasurements) by runId
    | where includeRework or coalesce(todouble(customMeasurements.rework), 0.0) == 0
    | project runId, dm = customMeasurements) on runId
| mv-expand k = bag_keys(pm) to typeof(string)
| where k startswith "obj_"
| extend key = substring(k, 4)
| extend objKind = tostring(split(key, "_")[0]), change = tostring(split(key, "_")[1]),
         planned = todouble(pm[k]), done = coalesce(todouble(dm[strcat("objDone_", key)]), 0.0)
| summarize tasks = dcount(runId), planned = sum(planned), done = sum(done) by objKind, change
| where planned > 0 or done > 0
| extend drift = done - planned,
         driftPct = iff(planned > 0, round(100.0 * (done - planned) / planned, 0), real(null))
| order by abs(drift) desc
content.title: Scope drift — planned vs delivered objects per kind

content.query:
let includeExcluded = false;
let minSchema = 3;
customEvents
| where name == "AldcRun" and toint(customDimensions.schema) >= minSchema
| where includeExcluded or tostring(customDimensions.exclude) != "true"
| extend runId = tostring(customDimensions.runId), attempt = todouble(customMeasurements.attempt),
         activeS = todouble(customMeasurements.activeSeconds), waveS = todouble(customMeasurements.waveSeconds)
| where isnotempty(runId) and waveS > 0
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, customDimensions) by runId, attempt, activeS, waveS
| extend ratio = round(activeS / waveS, 2), tier = tostring(customDimensions.tier)
| where ratio < 1
| project timestamp, runId, attempt, tier, activeMin = round(activeS / 60, 1), waveMin = round(waveS / 60, 1), ratio
| order by ratio asc
content.title: Clock check — runs whose activeSeconds is below the time inside their waves (should be empty)
